issue_context.title: Add support for determining if debugger is attached from runtime
issue_context.body:
To ensure that we are not doing debugging -related work needlessly, we need a way to ensure that a debugger is attached to the user application.

This is particularly relevant in the context of #42255 and other features that should only be run when in debugging mode.

A simple solution for this is presented in https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/pull/42255#issuecomment-694406441.
